Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Punjab Assistant Dietician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the HBCHRC Punjab recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Assistant Dietician. There is one vacancy available for this position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Dietician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Registered Dietician (RD) with an M.Sc. in Food Science & Nutrition or Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics. A minimum of 1 year of post-degree experience in a relevant field is required. Experience in Oncology Nutrition is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Dietician position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Dietician post is 30 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Dietician role?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for the Assistant Dietician position ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 35,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Assistant Dietician post?
faq.answer: This is a Walk-in recruitment. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview at the specified venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in interview date and time?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 29th September 2026, between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, Educational and Experience Certificates in original, and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Assistant Dietician post?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve an MCQ test if there are many candidates, followed by an interview.
